attack_surfaces.operation: money = money + bet (signed add at 0x18a6); bet check only verifies bet>=0 and money-bet>=0
attack_surfaces.reason: bet is signed 64-bit from scanf %lld. The check bet >= 0 (jns) and money - bet >= 0 (jns) allow large positive bets when money is sufficient. Combined with the target-derivation flaw, attacker can always guess correctly and accumulate money to exceed 1000000. The insufficient-money path loops back without exiting, allowing iterative betting. The win condition money>1000000 is reachable.

The random target number is derived from the player OWN guess input: target = (guess_input % 10) + 1, then compared against guess_input. For guess in 1..10, target = guess, so comparison always succeeds. This is a logic flaw making every guess a winning guess. Attacker controls both sides of the comparison.
